name: Im Diskodickicht
editorial_article: Im Diskodickicht is a track by German electronic musician Jan Jelinek, originally appearing on his 2005 album Kosmischer Pitch. Recorded and produced at the G. Guillaume studio in Berlin between 2004 and 2005, the track exemplifies Jelinek's approach to electronic music during this period, which drew heavily from 1970s German rock and utilized vintage synths, guitars, and drum sounds. The composition is characterized by trance-inducing repetition and subtle modulations that explore the manipulation of time, a concept Jelinek refers to as 'Pitch' in the album's title, referencing Wild Pitch House. The track, along with the rest of the album, was re-mastered by Giuseppe Ielasi and re-released in 2025 to mark the 20th anniversary of the original ~scape records release. Critics have noted the work's minimalist yet textured quality, describing it as a shadowy, ghost-like experience that morphs across space.
editorial_teaser: A hypnotic, minimalist composition from Jan Jelinek's acclaimed 2005 album Kosmischer Pitch, blending vintage instrumentation with electronic manipulation.
